title: NGS Clean Up Protocol for 96 Samples
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL DNA binding buffer to each well, mix thoroughly, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Ampure beads
steps.instruction: Add 8 µL Ampure beads to each well, mix thoroughly, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Magnetic separation of beads (5 min)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and allow beads to separate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the resulting supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (2×)
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with 50 µL of 80 % ethanol each time; do not mix after each addition.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL 80 % ethanol (Wash 1) and discard supernatant.
Add 50 µL 80 % ethanol (Wash 2) and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Centrifuge and place on magnet
steps.instruction: Manually centrifuge the plate, then replace it on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Remove residual supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a P20 pipette, remove any remaining supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Elute beads
steps.instruction: Add 7.6 µL elution buffer to each well, mix, and incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (3 min)
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and separate beads for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer elution to new plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 6.6 µL of the eluted DNA from each well to a new plate.
